answer: The nadir cap is applied at intake and inlet reveals the per-origin counts. At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a thread tag. A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a swarm in one epoch however much capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 27 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
